description: Rare Leica, camera, lens, and related used-market intelligence pack.
target_market_description: Leica / camera / lens rare used market with source-gap monitoring and condition-aware alerts.
user_problem: Collectors and buyers should not have to manually refresh many dealer pages for rare or underpriced camera items.
notes: Camera-specific aliases such as 35 lux aa, 50 cron, nocti, Leica R shorthand, and broad-query refinement belong here, not in core.

description: Luxury watch reference, dial, bracelet, papers/box, and condition-aware market pack.
target_market_description: Luxury watch references, vintage tool watches, and condition/provenance-sensitive listings.
user_problem: Watch buyers need reference-level alerts with dial and set completeness awareness, not just keyword search.
notes: Needs reference taxonomy, dial overlays, bracelet/reference compatibility, and authenticity-heavy source policy.

description: Obsolete industrial and electronic part sourcing pack with compatibility and stock-state overlays.
target_market_description: Discontinued industrial parts, PLC modules, servo drivers, ICs, sensors, and downtime-sensitive procurement.
user_problem: Parts buyers need part-number exactness, revision compatibility, and substitute risk awareness, not broad product matching.
notes: Core reuse is high, but compatibility mapping and safety policy make domain workload very high.

description: Vintage audio, synth, guitar, and microphone rare-gear alert pack.
target_market_description: Vintage synthesizers, mics, pedals, guitars, and provenance-sensitive studio gear.
user_problem: Buyers need model/year/modification-aware alerts and provenance-sensitive condition overlays.
notes: Needs year/model/serial aliasing and modification/original-parts overlays.

description: Classic motorcycle and vehicle-parts compatibility-aware market pack.
target_market_description: Classic motorcycles, vintage vehicle parts, OEM/aftermarket/reproduction-sensitive sourcing.
user_problem: Buyers need model-year and compatibility-aware alerts with domestic/export spec differences.
primary_user: Parts buyer, hobby restorer, specialist reseller
notes: Compatibility and OEM/reproduction risk make this higher-touch than Camera Bridge.

description: Cards, graded items, sealed collectibles, and limited-run goods alert pack.
target_market_description: Graded cards, sealed boxes, limited editions, figures, and run-size-sensitive collectibles.
user_problem: Collectors need grading, sealed/opened, edition, and authenticity-aware alerts rather than generic title matching.
notes: Grading overlays and authenticity policy are mandatory before launch.
